name: {flow}
tagline: Turns raw accomplishments into polished performance and award statements.
facts: Generates narrative performance statements sized to fill an exact number of form lines
Bullet Coach: per-statement tips plus a strength checklist (metric, $ or %, strong verb, mission impact, length fit)
Refine: shorten, lengthen or regenerate, each driven to the exact line target
Package Builder sorts statements into the right sections
Award Package Evaluator scores and ranks full packages, impact first
API key stays server-side; per-user token metering

shots.flow-generate: the real app: notes typed (0-3 s), Generate, Kojo charges up (4-5 s), three statements land (5.5 s on)
shots.flow-coach: the Coach strip opens on a statement: tips and the strength checklist
shots.flow-fit: Lengthen: 184/248 grows to 247/248, the meter goes green, Kojo calls PERFECT FIT (2 s)
shots.flow-save: Save a statement, the library opens with it on top

footage_note: flow-* clips are the real client UI with scripted AI text (tools/flow/demo-server.mjs); the sandbox has no API key.
